text: IMF staff assesses economic activity as moderating and external vulnerabilities elevated. Fiscal policies for 2024 and 2025 are viewed as appropriate, with the FY2024 primary surplus projected at 1.1 percent of GDP. Staff recommends a careful, data-driven monetary policy and assesses financial sector risks as low. Finally, staff supports the authorities' request for completion of the third reviews under the EFF and RSF, assessing implementation risks as manageable.
